details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:866-881 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: review_prepush_test_gate_acceptance_label_main reads `.labels` from `PR_META_FILE`, but the projection in scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh:250-256 only writes title/body/baseRefName/headRefName/headRepoFullName, so `[.labels[]?.name]` always gives `[]` and the label state is never "present".
  WHY: All reviewers rated this MAJOR. The DELETE branch (`state = met && has = yes`) never runs, so `ai:acceptance-unmet` is never removed once the check is met. While unmet, a POST runs on every committed review round, which breaks the plan's "at most 1 label write per review round, only on a state change". Four reviewers say `has` is always `no`; openai_gpt-6-luna says it stays `unknown`. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 notes that test_acceptance_label_writes_at_most_once only passes because it builds its own `pr_meta.json` with labels.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:800-825 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The label-sync check runs `jq` on `PR_META_FILE`, which may not contain the expected label metadata.
  WHY: When labels are missing, `has=no` is wrongly assumed, so the sync skips label removal or re-adds labels it should not (NIT).
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:6231-6240 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `ensure_label_exists "ai:acceptance-unmet" ... || true` hides a failed create (scripts/label_helpers.sh:214-215 returns 1), or the helper may not be defined at all, yet `PR_CREATE_ARGS+=(--label "${ACCEPTANCE_UNMET_LABEL}")` is still appended.
  WHY: All reviewers rated this MAJOR. `gh pr create` then fails with "could not add label ... not found", which does not match `pr_create_transient_re` at line 6254. The step reaches `exit 1` at line 6339 after the branch is already pushed, so no PR is opened and an advisory label becomes a hard failure.
- scripts/acceptance_check.py:549-571 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: gate_result increments `out["extra_unmet"]` for the status "unmet (passes on base)". That status comes from the merge-base tree's own copy of the test passing, so no edit on head can change it.
  WHY: All rated this MAJOR; confidence ranged from 3 to 5. Through `eff=$(( ${pr_caused:-0} + persist_extra ))`, the loop spends an editor turn and a full gate re-run that cannot lower `eff`, then stops with `no_progress`. minimax_minimax-m3 estimates 15-25 minutes wasted at the 5-turn cap.
- scripts/acceptance_check.py:532-546 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_test_status` scores a red-on-base target as met when `base_reason == "absent_on_base"`, even though the plan requires every red-on-base test to fail on the merge-base.
  WHY: Rated MAJOR by the four reviewers who flagged it. The done-check, the PR body `## Acceptance` section and the label can report success for a target that was never shown failing on base. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly rejected this in its pass-1 notes: a test file missing from the merge-base cannot pass there, and the fragment documents the rule.
- scripts/acceptance_check.py:557-571 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `extra_unmet` skips an unmet target whenever any PR-caused failure shares its file path, even a different test (also cited: scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:789-801, scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:758-771).
  WHY: Rated MAJOR by all three. After the unrelated failure is fixed, `eff` does not drop and `stop=no_progress` fires before the still-unmet target gets another repair turn. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this in pass-1 because gate units are file-level.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:694-700 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The attempt-journal candidate selection only checks `prepush_gate/run2|run1/result.json`, but the new loop can finish in run3..run6.
  WHY: Rated MAJOR by all three. A final pass in run3+ is journaled with an earlier run's status, or a final failure is missed. implement.yml:6362-6366 was widened but review_commit_changes.sh was not.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:990-1048 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new `_baseline_target_statuses` run (line 990) and the existing `classify_baseline` (line 1035) each get a `max(deadline, time.monotonic() + BASELINE_MIN_SECS)` floor of 90 s, so together they can run about 180 s past the deadline.
  WHY: All rated this MAJOR; confidence ranged from 3 to 4. scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh sets `wall=$(( timeout_minutes * 60 + 120 ))` with `timeout --kill-after=30s`. The container is killed (rc 124/137) and a synthetic `container_rc_*` result replaces the real one, dropping all failures, `pr_caused` and `acceptance`, so the repair turn never runs.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:866-889 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The review-side label POST/DELETE in acceptance_label_main does not call `ensure_label_exists`, unlike implement.yml:6236-6237 and the label-precreation convention.
  WHY: All rated this NIT. In a consumer repo the POST may fail, or GitHub auto-creates a label that does not match the catalog (fbca04, "The PR does not yet meet its plan's done-check"). This conflicts with tests/test_ai_label_precreation_contract.py.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:835-837 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The review-side POST does not use ensure_label_exists.
  WHY: In consumer repos this relies on GitHub auto-creating the label, which may not match the catalog (color, description) or may fail entirely (NIT).
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:835-838; scripts/acceptance_check.py:605-618; scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1315-1319 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The done-check `fetch-plan` re-reads the paginated `repos/{repo}/issues/{n}/comments` through `attempt_journal.load_comments` without `--comments-file`, instead of reusing comments already fetched or read for the journal render.
  WHY: All rated this NIT. Each round makes two or more comment reads (4-6 API calls with pagination), over the P3 budget of "at most 1 comments read". `--comments-file` is already supported (scripts/acceptance_check.py:674), and the comments are already on disk at `${RUNTIME_DIR}/pr_issue_comments.json`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3836-3839 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `if:` on the "Sync done-check label" step lacks the `vars.PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_MODE != 'off'` clause that the prepare step (line 3797) and the gate step (line 3810) have.
  WHY: Both rated this NIT. With the gate off and the repair loop on, the step still runs; today it stops with `reason=no_result`, but a stale result.json could silently apply or remove `ai:acceptance-unmet`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3791-3805, 3833-3848 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Token use in the label-sync steps has no guard.
  WHY: A regression in the conditions could silently drop the label or add it by mistake (NIT).
- tests/test_acceptance_check.py:538-558 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The _plan_comment tie-breaker picks the last comment when timestamps tie, which is brittle.
  WHY: This is safe today but depends on login normalization; if that fails, a forged comment could be picked (NIT).
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:6366 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: If RUNTIME_DIR is unset, the result path resolves to /prepush_gate/run...
  WHY: That points at the wrong result files (NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Plan P3 item 5: "`scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh` main (579+) and its `--phase resolver` use: the same loop over `rpg_*`."
  expected_change_site: review_prepush_test_gate_cmd_gate in scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh and its caller in scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh (`_resolver_prepush_test_gate`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Only review_prepush_test_gate_main calls review_prepush_test_gate_persist_loop. The `gate` subcommand (line 1185; help text at review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:1124-1178 says "no caller yet") only passes through `--tests-file`/`--expect-baseline-fail-file`. scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:1070-1077 still does run1, one repair, then optionally run2. The fetch step's `if:` excludes `AUTOFIX_PRE_REVIEW_RESOLVE=true`. The agents fragment says "The resolver keeps its single repair", which narrows P3's scope without flagging it as a blocker, and review_conflict_resolve.sh is outside files_touched. Severity: MAJOR from four reviewers, NIT from z-ai_glm-5_3-flash.
- requirement: Plan P3 item 5: "The done-check comes from the linked issue's plan comment, read from the comments review already fetches." Plan P3 item 8: API use is limited to the label write.
  expected_change_site: scripts/acceptance_check.py `fetch_plan` and the "Prepare done-check (repair loop)" step in .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: fetch_plan calls attempt_journal.load_comments without a comments file. That is a new paginated read, plus `gh api user` when the login is not cached, on every review round, and review_apply_fixes.sh (~line 1318) reads the same comments again. The call site has no §14 audit comment, and the already-fetched review comments are not reused. Both reviewers rated this NIT.
- requirement: The repair loop's final gate result must reach the attempt journal (the PR's agents fragment calls the current behaviour a "Known gap").
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_commit_changes.sh (selection of `prepush_gate/run2|run1/result.json` for the attempt journal)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: implement.yml line 6366 was widened to check run6..run3 first, but scripts/review_commit_changes.sh has no hunk and does not search run3-run6, so a round ending in run3+ journals the second run's status. The file is outside files_touched. Severity: NIT from anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, MAJOR from google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite.
- requirement: Linked issue #8489 acceptance criterion: "The P3 deliverables and tests listed in the plan are implemented and pass."
  expected_change_site: the PR's test suite on head commit 1a801116 (the pre-push test gate)
  confidence=4
